summary: Limited-time Deepgram promotion: every $1 of paid Flux TTS usage earns $1 in bonus credits, up to $500 per eligible project. Open to new and existing Pay-As-You-Go and Growth projects (Enterprise excluded); a valid payment method is required. Runs from 12:00 a.m. Pacific Time on September 15 through 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time on December 31, 2026. Bonus credits never expire, are nontransferable, and apply only to later Deepgram API usage in the project that earned them; usage cannot be pooled across projects. Other discounts, promotional codes/credits, referral or partner/program credits, and negotiated pricing cannot be combined without Deepgram's written permission. The standard $200 signup credit is an exception and can be kept alongside the bonus, but usage funded by it or any promotional credit earns no match. Auto-reload is optional; if enabled, it automatically charges the payment method according to Billing settings.
claim_steps: Use a Deepgram Pay-As-You-Go or Growth project with a valid payment method on file.

Spend paid credits on Flux TTS from 12:00 a.m. Pacific Time Sep 15 through 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time Dec 31, 2026. Usage paid with promotional credits, including the standard $200 signup credit or earned bonuses, does not qualify.
Bonus credits are granted to the earning project, typically within 1 week, for later API usage there. They are nontransferable; do not pool usage across projects.

Do not combine other discounts, promotions, referral/partner credits or negotiated pricing without Deepgram's written approval. The standard $200 signup credit is the exception, but spending it earns no match.
Auto-reload is optional, not required for the promotion. If enabled, it automatically charges your payment method per Billing settings; review, change or disable it there.

social_proof.title: Deepgram Pricing
social_proof.text: Buy Flux TTS, get matching credits. For every $1 you spend on Flux TTS, we'll add $1 in credits — up to $500. Available on Pay As You Go and Growth plans. Offer ends December 31, 2026.

social_proof.title: Deepgram — Flux TTS Credit Bonus Promotion Terms
social_proof.text: The Promotion begins at 12:00 a.m. Pacific Time on September 15, 2026 and ends at 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time on December 31, 2026. Up to $500 in Bonus Credits per Eligible Project.

social_proof.title: Flux TTS promotion terms §3.7 — stacking exception
social_proof.text: The Promotion may not be combined with any other discount, promotional code, credit, referral, partner/program credit, or negotiated pricing unless Deepgram permits it in writing. This restriction does not apply to Deepgram's standard $200 in free sign-up credits, which every new account receives and which participants keep in addition to the Bonus Credits, however, usage paid with sign-up credits is not Qualifying Usage.

social_proof.title: Flux TTS promotion terms §3.6 — project-specific credits
social_proof.text: The Promotion and Bonus Credits are specific to the Eligible Project and may not be sold, assigned, transferred, or applied to any other account or project.

social_proof.title: Flux TTS promotion terms §4.2 — optional auto-reload
social_proof.text: Auto-reload is not a condition of the Promotion. If Auto-reload is enabled, your payment method will be automatically charged to replenish your balance per your Billing settings; you can review, change, or disable Auto-reload at any time in Billing.
